mapper.sql: id, user_id, type, status, reason, admin_note, previous_status, starts_at, expires_at, released_at, released_by, released_via, release_reason, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_sanctions (user_id, type, status, reason, admin_note, previous_status, starts_at, expires_at, created_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{status}, #{reason}, #{adminNote}, #{previousStatus}, #{startsAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_sanctions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT FROM user_sanctions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM user_sanctions WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM user_sanctions WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND type = 'TEMPORARY' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY expires_at
mapper.update: UPDATE user_sanctions SET status = #{status}, released_at = #{releasedAt}, released_by = #{releasedBy}, released_via = #{releasedVia}, release_reason = #{releaseReason} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
